declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.unitInterval
declarations.signature:
def unitInterval : Domain ℝ where
  carrier := Icc 0 1
  nonempty := ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
  closed := isClosed_Icc
  convex := convex_Icc 0 1

definitionAudit.fields: nonempty, closed and convex are proved witnesses, not caller hypotheses
definitionAudit.projection: Previously accepted Domain/project and complete existence-uniqueness/specification are supplied as compiler-elaborated context; no new fallback definition.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.project_unitInterval
declarations.signature:
theorem project_unitInterval (z : ℝ) :
    project unitInterval z = min (max z 0) 1

inputs.reason: Projection formula applies on the full real carrier, not just feasible input.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.square_regular
declarations.signature:
theorem square_regular (y : ℝ) :
    RegularLoss unitInterval (fun x : ℝ => (x-y)^2)

inputs.reason: Unrestricted real shift; result produces global square-loss regularity.

declarations.expandedResult: Exists open U containing [0,1], ConvexOn Real U squareLoss and DifferentiableOn Real squareLoss U. The proof supplies U=univ. This stronger historical API is produced, never assumed by example_2_14.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.gradient_square
declarations.signature:
theorem gradient_square (y x : ℝ) :
    gradient (fun x : ℝ => (x-y)^2) x = 2 * (x-y)

inputs.reason: Ambient real square derivative; full real-domain identity generalizes the interval application.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.gradient_square_bound
declarations.signature:
theorem gradient_square_bound (y x : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : ‖gradient (fun x : ℝ => (x-y)^2) x‖ ≤ 2

inputs.reason: Real label and decision.
Feasible label required by this uniform bound.
Feasible action required by this uniform bound.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.square_step_clamp
declarations.signature:
theorem square_step_clamp (η y x : ℝ) :
    step unitInterval η (fun x : ℝ => (x-y)^2) x =
      min (max (x - 2 * η * (x-y)) 0) 1

inputs.reason: Algebraic identity of one update for every real step and inputs; not a regret guarantee for arbitrary steps.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.example_2_14
declarations.signature:
theorem example_2_14 (y : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 : ℝ) (hx0 : x0 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      regret unitInterval (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt T)) (fun t x => (x-y t)^2) x0 u T ≤
        2 * Real.sqrt T

inputs.binder: y : Nat -> Real, x0 : Real, T : Nat
inputs.reason: Label sequence, initial action and finite horizon.
Algorithm2.1 starts at a feasible point; no fixed initialization is required.
Positive known horizon for positive tuned step; empty-horizon totalized expression is not this guarantee.

inputs.binder: hy : forall t < T, 0 <= y t and y t <= 1
inputs.reason: Real labels within the guessing-game interval, not binary-only.
Guarantee against each fixed feasible comparator, represented inside the conclusion.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.guessing_zero_trajectory
declarations.signature:
theorem guessing_zero_trajectory (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℕ) :
    iterate unitInterval (1/(4*(n:ℝ))) (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 t =
      (1 - 1/(2*(n:ℝ)))^t

inputs.reason: Step tuning parameter and trajectory index.
Explicit condition of this derived geometric-trajectory lemma; not a new premise of Example2.14.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.guessing_tuned_eta_square
declarations.signature:
theorem guessing_tuned_eta_square (n : ℕ) :
    1/(2*Real.sqrt (((2*n)^2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 1/(4*(n:ℝ))

inputs.reason: Algebraic step identity valid also at n=0 under Lean total real division.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.guessing_squared_horizon_lower
declarations.signature:
theorem guessing_squared_horizon_lower (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (n:ℝ)/4 ≤ regret unitInterval (1/(2*Real.sqrt (((2*n)^2 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
      (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 0 ((2*n)^2)

inputs.reason: Square horizon parameter.
Derived lower witness uses positive step and horizon, fixed initial action1 and all-zero labels.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.meanPredict_zero_cumulativeLoss
declarations.signature:
theorem meanPredict_zero_cumulativeLoss (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T,
      (BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ)) t)^2) = 1/4

inputs.reason: Finite horizon.
Includes the fixed initial square loss1/4; at T=0 the sum is0.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.guessing_vs_mean_lower
declarations.signature:
theorem guessing_vs_mean_lower (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (n : ℝ)/4 - 1/4 ≤
      regret unitInterval (1/(2*Real.sqrt (((2*n)^2 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
        (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 0 ((2*n)^2) -
      (∑ t ∈ range ((2*n)^2),
        (BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ)) t)^2)

inputs.reason: Same square horizon for both losses.
Derived concrete comparison, with different explicitly fixed initializations.

declarations.name: BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.guessing_vs_mean_unbounded
declarations.signature:
theorem guessing_vs_mean_unbounded (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, N < n ∧
      C < regret unitInterval (1/(2*Real.sqrt (((2*n)^2 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
        (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 0 ((2*n)^2) -
      (∑ t ∈ range ((2*n)^2),
        (BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ)) t)^2)

inputs.reason: Arbitrary threshold and lower index cutoff precede the existential tuning index n.

declarations.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingOGD.labels
declarations.signature: noncomputable def labels (t : ℕ) : ℝ := if t = 0 then 1 else 0

inputs.reason: Deterministic test stream.

declarations.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingOGD.losses
declarations.signature: noncomputable def losses (t : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ := (x-labels t)^2

inputs.reason: Actual square losses of the test stream.

declarations.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingOGD.first_projected
declarations.signature: lemma first_projected : iterate unitInterval 1 losses (1/2) 1 = 1

declarations.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingOGD.second_projected
declarations.signature: lemma second_projected : iterate unitInterval 1 losses (1/2) 2 = 0

declarations.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingOGD.source_four_rounds
declarations.signature:
lemma source_four_rounds : ∀ u ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
    regret unitInterval (1/4) losses (1/2) u 4 ≤ 4

inputs.reason: Instantiates the upper guarantee at T4, eta1/4, initialization1/2.

declarations.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingLower.first_state
declarations.signature: lemma first_state : iterate unitInterval (1/16) (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 1 = 7/8

declarations.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingLower.source_lower
declarations.signature: lemma source_lower : 1 ≤ regret unitInterval (1/16) (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 0 64

declarations.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingComparison.actual_zero_stream_gap
declarations.signature:
lemma actual_zero_stream_gap :
    (3/4 : ℝ) ≤
      regret unitInterval (1/16) (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 0 64 -
      (∑ t ∈ range 64,
        (BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ)) t)^2)

source_lean_deltas.detail: Real interval actions and labels, actual projected square-gradient recurrence, strict-past action at index t and feedback y_t only in next update; no probabilistic assumptions.
T positive and known for each tuned run. Zero-based indices enumerate source rounds1 throughT; x0 is source first action.
Ambient gradient and clamp identities hold on arbitrary real arguments and arbitrary real step; the regret theorem still uses the exact positive horizon-tuned step.
Source gives O(sqrt T); finite constant2 at eta1/(2sqrt T) is a derived instantiation of accepted D1,L2 bound, not a verbatim source numeral.

boundary: Positive known horizon, all feasible comparators and arbitrary feasible initialization for the upper guarantee. Concrete zero stream, square horizons and separately horizon-tuned runs for the lower/comparison. OGD starts at one while the mean starts at one half.
